title: Evaluating the Fragility and Error Compounding of Multi-Step Agentic Systems
author_or_organization: Arvind Narayanan, Sayash Kapoor, Christoph Rabanser
limitations: Analytical and mathematical treatment of probabilistic agent loops demonstrating error compounding (P = p^n) across multi-step execution graphs. Establishes the mathematical necessity of deterministic checkpoints, but relies on generalized error assumptions rather than a single proprietary benchmark.
